title: Authentic and Simulated Project-Based Learning to Improve Students’ Employability Skills and Their Translator Competence
core_idea: Compare authentic versus simulated project-based learning to determine their effects on translation students' employability skills and translator competence using a mixed-method design (documentary analysis and two self-report questionnaires), and examine an authentic PjBL procedure as a potential model to connect university curriculum with industry practice.
tldr: This mixed-method study investigates whether authentic and simulated project-based learning differ in improving translation students' employability skills and translator competence and evaluates an authentic PjBL procedure as a bridge between curriculum and industry.
